order_connection_origin.name: order_connection_origin
order_connection_origin.value: ("canonical_orders"."source" = 'MANUAL' AND "canonical_orders"."connection_id" IS NULL) OR ("canonical_orders"."source" <> 'MANUAL' AND "canonical_orders"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL)

connections_state.name: connections_state
connections_state.value: "connections"."state" IN ('ACTIVE','DISABLED') AND ("connections"."state" <> 'ACTIVE' OR "connections"."external_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

erp_destinations_endpoint.name: erp_destinations_endpoint
erp_destinations_endpoint.value: ("erp_destinations"."state" <> 'ACTIVE' OR "erp_destinations"."endpoint_origin" IS NOT NULL) AND ("erp_destinations"."endpoint_origin" IS NULL OR "erp_destinations"."endpoint_origin" ~ '^http://127[.]0[.]0[.]1:[0-9]{1,5}$')

workspaces_owner_kind.name: workspaces_owner_kind
workspaces_owner_kind.value: ("workspaces"."kind" = 'ACCOUNT' AND "workspaces"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("workspaces"."kind" = 'LEGACY_CLOSED' AND "workspaces"."owner_id" IS NULL)
